references.text: The section begins with Achan's sin of taking the devoted things, as this verse reveals when they find the hidden objects.
Achan confesses his sin and describes exactly what he took and where he hid it, which is now confirmed when the messengers find them.
The next verse describes what happens after they found the hidden items—they bring them to Joshua and all Israel.
Joshua's command to stay away from the devoted things, which Achan broke by hiding the items in his tent.
The principle that sin will find the sinner—Achan's hidden sin was exposed.
He who covers hatred with deceit, his wickedness shall be revealed to the assembly—illustrates the principle that hidden sin is brought to light.
